courses.summary: 以取樣值、精準時鐘與程序匯流排可靠度串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect sampled values, precise clocks and process-bus reliability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.textEn: For eight streams, 4800 frames/s each and 160 on-wire bytes/frame, raw load is 49.152 Mbit/s. Other traffic and burst buffers are excluded; mean rate alone cannot prove lossless transport.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較事件持續性與重複模式。 比較差異是否符合「暫態故障與持續故障需不同事件分類。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare persistence and repetition patterns. Compare the result against: Transient and persistent faults need different classification. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較事件持續性與重複模式。
steps.observationEn: Compare persistence and repetition patterns.

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for temporary versus permanent; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結

courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

功率餘額與可持續時間需分別驗算。
只調整「能量需求」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping energy needs verification.
Power margin and duration require separate checks.
Tuning the displayed energy needs result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 功率餘額與可持續時間需分別驗算。 計算 kW 和 kWh 雙預算。
quiz.explanationEn: Power margin and duration require separate checks. Calculate both kW and kWh budgets.

steps.title: 能量需求：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「能量需求」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for energy needs.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。計算 kW 和 kWh 雙預算。 比較差異是否符合「功率餘額與可持續時間需分別驗算。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Calculate both kW and kWh budgets. Compare the result against: Power margin and duration require separate checks. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 計算 kW 和 kWh 雙預算。
steps.observationEn: Calculate both kW and kWh budgets.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「能量需求」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping energy needs verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「能量需求」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for energy needs; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

Droop shares power while retaining steady frequency deviation. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare primary droop and secondary restoration. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.

steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for frequency droop; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

courses.summary: 以孤島功率平衡、同步條件與轉換動態串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect island power balance, synchronization and transition dynamics through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.textEn: For island load 500 kW and generation 300 kW, a battery supplies 200 kW. Thirty minutes requires 100 kWh AC, or 111.11 kWh available DC at 0.90 discharge efficiency, before SOC reserve and aging.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假想下垂係數 m=0.05 Hz/kW，新增有功 10 kW 導致一次控制頻率變化 Δf=−mΔP=−0.5 Hz。此斜率只供小型模型，未定義實際並網規範，二次控制可另行恢復頻率。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical droop m=0.05 Hz/kW and +10 kW load, primary Δf=−mΔP=−0.5 Hz. This small-model slope is not a grid requirement; secondary control can restore frequency.

courses.summary: 以電壓成形、下垂與限流穩定性串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect voltage formation, droop and current-limit stability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Sweep window length and decision delay. Compare the result against: Filter delay affects undervoltage and frequency decisions. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 掃描視窗長度與事件延遲。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for measurement transients; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.textEn: Sweep window length and decision delay. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設 1 MVA 逆變器、線電壓 400 V，額定 I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A。若短時限流為假設的 1.2 pu，短時 RMS 電流上限 1732.1 A；這不是實際產品或標準限值。
knowledge.textEn: For an assumed 1 MVA inverter at line voltage 400 V, rated I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A. An illustrative 1.2 pu short-term RMS limit is 1732.1 A, not a product or standards limit.

courses.summary: 以併網邊界、故障穿越與孤島辨識串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect interconnection boundaries, ride-through and island detection through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設 1 MVA 逆變器、線電壓 400 V，額定 I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A。若短時限流為假設的 1.2 pu，短時 RMS 電流上限 1732.1 A；這不是實際產品或標準限值。
workedExample.textEn: For an assumed 1 MVA inverter at line voltage 400 V, rated I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A. An illustrative 1.2 pu short-term RMS limit is 1732.1 A, not a product or standards limit.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 列不能依賴的外部輔助系統。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: List unavailable external auxiliaries. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設站用負載 100 kW 持續 2 h，加一次馬達起動交流能量 10 kWh，總交流需求 210 kWh；效率 0.9 需 233.33 kWh 可用直流能量。能量足夠仍不能證明瞬時起動電流能力。
knowledge.textEn: Assume auxiliaries draw 100 kW for 2 h plus one motor start requiring 10 kWh AC: total is 210 kWh AC, or 233.33 kWh available DC at 0.9 efficiency. Energy sufficiency does not prove starting-current capability.

quiz.question: 審查「黑啟動定義」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？

只調整「黑啟動定義」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: A black-start resource establishes supply without external AC.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping black-start definition verification.
Tuning the displayed black-start definition result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.

courses.summary: 以啟動能源、復電路徑與動態負載串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect starting energy, restoration paths and dynamic loads through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for model order.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較逐項加入的特徵值。 比較差異是否符合「省略勵磁或負載動態會改變模態。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare eigenvalues as models are added. Compare the result against: Omitting excitation or load dynamics changes modes. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較逐項加入的特徵值。
steps.observationEn: Compare eigenvalues as models are added.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「模型階數」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping model order verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「模型階數」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for model order; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 省略勵磁或負載動態會改變模態。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting excitation or load dynamics changes modes.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較逐項加入的特徵值。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare eigenvalues as models are added. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

quiz.question: 審查「模型階數」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for model order?
options: 比較逐項加入的特徵值。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「模型階數」的驗證。
只調整「模型階數」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Compare eigenvalues as models are added.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping model order verification.
Tuning the displayed model order result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 省略勵磁或負載動態會改變模態。 比較逐項加入的特徵值。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting excitation or load dynamics changes modes. Compare eigenvalues as models are added.

steps.title: 參數基準：模型與設計

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for parameter bases.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「參數基準」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。慣量及阻抗需換到一致系統基準。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「用實際能量與歐姆值核對。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for parameter bases, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Inertia and impedance need consistent system bases. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Cross-check physical energy and ohms. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 用實際能量與歐姆值核對。
steps.observationEn: Cross-check physical energy and ohms.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「參數基準」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。

steps.check: 提交「參數基準」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「用實際能量與歐姆值核對。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for parameter bases; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

courses.summary: 以模態、暫態功角與頻率動態串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect modes, transient rotor angle and frequency dynamics through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設線性特徵值 λ=−0.5 s⁻¹ ± j6 rad/s，振盪頻率 6/(2π)=0.955 Hz，阻尼比 ζ=0.5/√(0.5²+6²)=0.0830。此線性模態只適用給定工作點附近。
workedExample.textEn: For λ=−0.5 s⁻¹ ± j6 rad/s, oscillation frequency is 6/(2π)=0.955 Hz and damping ratio ζ=0.5/√(0.5²+6²)=0.0830. This linear mode applies only near the chosen operating point.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

stages.title: 資源與基線
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「資源與基線」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop resources and baseline through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 資源分類：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「資源分類」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for resource classes.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「資源分類」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「以能量守恆分類負載行為。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for resource classes, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Classify behavior using energy balance. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 以能量守恆分類負載行為。
steps.observationEn: Classify behavior using energy balance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「資源分類」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping resource classes verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「資源分類」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「以能量守恆分類負載行為。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for resource classes; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。
knowledge.textEn: Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 以能量守恆分類負載行為。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Classify behavior using energy balance. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設反事實基線 100 kW，事件平均實測 70 kW、持續 2 h，估计降低能量 60 kWh。若基線可能偏差 ±10 kW，僅此項造成 ±20 kWh 範圍；不等於直接量得節能量。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a counterfactual baseline 100 kW and measured event mean 70 kW for 2 h: estimated reduction is 60 kWh. Baseline error ±10 kW alone gives ±20 kWh; savings are not directly measured.

quiz.question: 審查「資源分類」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for resource classes?
options: 可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「資源分類」的驗證。
只調整「資源分類」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping resource classes verification.
Tuning the displayed resource classes result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。 以能量守恆分類負載行為。
quiz.explanationEn: Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ. Classify behavior using energy balance.

steps.title: 資源分類：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「資源分類」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for resource classes.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。以能量守恆分類負載行為。 比較差異是否符合「可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Classify behavior using energy balance. Compare the result against: Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 以能量守恆分類負載行為。
steps.observationEn: Classify behavior using energy balance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「資源分類」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping resource classes verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「資源分類」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for resource classes; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

courses.summary: 以基線、可調負載與需量反應驗證串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect baselines, flexible loads and demand-response verification through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.textEn: Assume a counterfactual baseline 100 kW and measured event mean 70 kW for 2 h: estimated reduction is 60 kWh. Baseline error ±10 kW alone gives ±20 kWh; savings are not directly measured.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for antialiasing, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據

knowledge.textEn: Check aliasing using known high-frequency models. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

Tuning the displayed antialiasing result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
Above-Nyquist signals alias into false frequencies.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 保留缺測、估算及實測旗標。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結

courses.summary: 以同步取樣、功率積分與計量不確定度串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect synchronous sampling, power integration and metrology uncertainty through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。

stages.title: 量測與指標

steps.title: THD 與 TDD：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: THD versus TDD: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「THD 與 TDD」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for thd versus tdd.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「THD 與 TDD」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for thd versus tdd, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Recalculate both metrics at low/high load. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate both metrics at low/high load.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「THD 與 TDD」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping thd versus tdd verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「THD 與 TDD」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for thd versus tdd; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate both metrics at low/high load. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設基頻電流 100 A RMS，5、7 次各 10 A 及 5 A，THD=√(10²+5²)/100=11.18%；總 RMS=√10125≈100.62 A。僅兩次諧波，不代表電壓 THD。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fundamental 100 A RMS with fifth/seventh harmonics 10 and 5 A. THD=√(10²+5²)/100=11.18%; total RMS=√10125≈100.62 A. Only two harmonics are included, not voltage THD.

quiz.question: 審查「THD 與 TDD」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？

options: 不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「THD 與 TDD」的驗證。
只調整「THD 與 TDD」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping thd versus tdd verification.
Tuning the displayed thd versus tdd result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。 在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。
quiz.explanationEn: Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning. Recalculate both metrics at low/high load.

steps.title: THD 與 TDD：量測與判讀

steps.objective: 針對「THD 與 TDD」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。

steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping thd versus tdd verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.

courses.summary: 以諧波頻譜、共振及主動補償容量串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect harmonic spectra, resonance and active compensation capacity through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.

courses.summary: 以拓撲、狀態估計與模型版本一致性串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect topology, state estimation and model revision consistency through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

courses.summary: 以晶矽電池互連、封裝應力及模組失效串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect crystalline-silicon interconnection, package stress and module failures through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設 60 個相同電池串聯，各 Vmp=0.60 V、Imp=10 A，理想模組 Pmp=360 W；總串聯電阻 0.10 Ω 在 10 A 時損失 10 W。此固定工作點估算忽略互連後最佳功率點移動。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 60 identical series cells, each Vmp=0.60 V and Imp=10 A: ideal Pmp=360 W. Total series resistance 0.10 Ω loses 10 W at 10 A. This fixed-point estimate omits the shifted maximum-power point.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。

stages.title: 材料與基板
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「材料與基板」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop materials and substrate through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 材料選擇：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「材料選擇」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for material selection.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「材料選擇」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for material selection, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: List bandgap, absorption and stability differences. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。
steps.observationEn: List bandgap, absorption and stability differences.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「材料選擇」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping material selection verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「材料選擇」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for material selection; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。
knowledge.textEn: CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: List bandgap, absorption and stability differences. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設吸收係數 α=10⁶ m⁻¹、厚度 d=2 μm，理想無反射單程吸收 1−exp(−αd)=86.47%；d=3 μm 時為 95.02%。未包含載子收集及前後電極損失，因此不是效率。
knowledge.textEn: Assume α=10⁶ m⁻¹ and d=2 μm: ideal reflection-free single-pass absorption 1−exp(−αd)=86.47%; at 3 μm it is 95.02%. Collection and electrode losses are omitted, so this is not efficiency.

quiz.question: 審查「材料選擇」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for material selection?
options: CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「材料選擇」的驗證。
只調整「材料選擇」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping material selection verification.
Tuning the displayed material selection result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。 列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。
quiz.explanationEn: CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters. List bandgap, absorption and stability differences.

steps.title: 材料選擇：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「材料選擇」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for material selection.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。 比較差異是否符合「CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。

Compare the result against: CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「材料選擇」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping material selection verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「材料選擇」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for material selection; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

steps.title: P2 互連：模型與設計

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for p2 interconnect, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Intermediate openings need low-resistance series contact. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Pair contact resistance with effective width. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 將接觸阻值與有效接触寬度配對。

courses.summary: 以薄膜吸收層、單片互連與長期穩定串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect thin-film absorbers, monolithic interconnects and durability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

quiz.question: 審查「產能監測」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？

Attribute using weather normalization and status codes.

courses.summary: 以MPPT、直流鏈與三相併網控制串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect mppt, dc links and three-phase interconnection control through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 模組與輸入
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「模組與輸入」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop module and input through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 模組級控制：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「模組級控制」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for module-level control.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「模組級控制」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。獨立 MPPT 可減少模組間失配耦合。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for module-level control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare architectures with identical shading maps. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。
steps.observationEn: Compare architectures with identical shading maps.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「模組級控制」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping module-level control verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「模組級控制」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for module-level control; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 獨立 MPPT 可減少模組間失配耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare architectures with identical shading maps. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設單相輸出 300 W、50 Hz，直流鏈 Vdc=400 V、C=100 μF；小波紋且無其他解耦時，雙頻電壓波紋峰值約 ΔV=P/(2ωCV)=11.94 V，ω=2π×50。峰對峰約 23.87 V，不是設計規格。
knowledge.textEn: For single-phase 300 W at 50 Hz with Vdc=400 V and C=100 μF, small-ripple double-frequency voltage amplitude is ΔV≈P/(2ωCV)=11.94 V, ω=2π×50; peak-to-peak≈23.87 V without other decoupling. This is not a design specification.

optionsEn: Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping module-level control verification.
Tuning the displayed module-level control result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.

steps.title: 模組級控制：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「模組級控制」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for module-level control.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。 比較差異是否符合「獨立 MPPT 可減少模組間失配耦合。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare architectures with identical shading maps. Compare the result against: Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。
steps.observationEn: Compare architectures with identical shading maps.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「模組級控制」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping module-level control verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「模組級控制」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for module-level control; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for tracking and ripple.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「追蹤與波紋」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。雙頻波紋可能干扰 MPPT 估計。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較瞬時及濾波後功率判斷。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for tracking and ripple, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Double-frequency ripple can disturb MPPT estimates. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare instantaneous and filtered power decisions. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較瞬時及濾波後功率判斷。
steps.observationEn: Compare instantaneous and filtered power decisions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「追蹤與波紋」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping tracking and ripple verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「追蹤與波紋」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較瞬時及濾波後功率判斷。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for tracking and ripple; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 雙頻波紋可能干扰 MPPT 估計。
knowledge.textEn: Double-frequency ripple can disturb MPPT estimates.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較瞬時及濾波後功率判斷。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare instantaneous and filtered power decisions. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

quiz.question: 審查「追蹤與波紋」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for tracking and ripple?
options: 雙頻波紋可能干扰 MPPT 估計。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「追蹤與波紋」的驗證。
只調整「追蹤與波紋」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Double-frequency ripple can disturb MPPT estimates.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping tracking and ripple verification.
Tuning the displayed tracking and ripple result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 雙頻波紋可能干扰 MPPT 估計。 比較瞬時及濾波後功率判斷。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-frequency ripple can disturb MPPT estimates. Compare instantaneous and filtered power decisions.

steps.title: 追蹤與波紋：量測與判讀

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較瞬時及濾波後功率判斷。 比較差異是否符合「雙頻波紋可能干扰 MPPT 估計。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare instantaneous and filtered power decisions. Compare the result against: Double-frequency ripple can disturb MPPT estimates. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較瞬時及濾波後功率判斷。
steps.observationEn: Compare instantaneous and filtered power decisions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「追蹤與波紋」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping tracking and ripple verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「追蹤與波紋」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for tracking and ripple; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

courses.summary: 以模組級 MPPT、功率解耦與屋頂熱可靠度串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect module-level mppt, power decoupling and rooftop thermal reliability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

courses.summary: 以太陽方位、雙軸運動學與風載退避串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect sun position, dual-axis kinematics and wind stow through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
courses.scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.
